annotations.title: Look up planting windows for a place

description: When to start seeds indoors, plant out, and sow for a fall harvest at any place, crop by crop, with the days left to sow today. Works without a Siltwell account. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Without crops, it returns the 30 crops with the soonest next step; pass crops to see others. For the signed-in user's own garden, get_plan returns sowing and transplant windows for the garden's own plants, counted from its microclimate-adjusted last frost date.

crops.description: Crop names to include, for example ["tomato", "garlic"]. Omit to get the 30 crops with the soonest next step.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Give it with longitude instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Give it with latitude instead of place.

place.description: Town plus region or country, for example "Portland, Oregon". Omit it to use the signed-in user's garden.

name: lookup_planting_windows
title: Look up planting windows for a place
